Consensus is an AI search engine for peer-reviewed academic literature, positioned as a tool for finding, organizing, and analyzing science faster.

The available record identifies one product, Consensus, in the search, research, translation and other category. The company describes it as a research operating system, but the data includes no compute, building, or power metrics, so it offers no basis for assessing infrastructure constraints.

The absence of lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, and patent records means the available material does not document those activities, not that they are absent in reality. This record cannot support any claim about grid or compute scaling for the company.
